description: This file is a unit test class for the PerformanceReviewAllowedActionsAPI within the OrangeHRM system. It contains test methods that validate the API's behavior, particularly for retrieving allowed actions related to performance reviews. It extends test infrastructure classes and uses data providers for multiple test cases.
